knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The floor is left until last so that dust and drips from the earlier stages land on it and are removed in the final clean.
A drain that is used rarely can lose its water seal, which lets odour rise; running water through it restores the seal.
Protection and warning come first, before any surface is touched or any chemical is opened.

practicalCriteria: Restocks and sets out the washroom sign before any surface is touched.
Completes the order: high points, wet fixtures, polish, touchpoints, floor, then drains.
Checks the finished washroom against the standard and corrects any failed check before sign-off.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark, so all three must be correct. The practical sign-off is separate, observed by an assessor, and is not shown by a quiz result.
evidenceRequired: Observed practical sign-off on assessor sheet
Job record or photo of the finished area
stopWorkCriteria: Chemical opened or handled without gloves and eye protection
Dirty water or residue left on the floor while people are nearby
